summary: A generic 8x8 wheeled armoured personnel carrier: a faceted welded hull with a shallow upper glacis, a V-bell… joints ramp, driver_hatch, steering, troop_hatch_l, troop_hatch_r, turret, …; options paint; sockets seat_driver, seat_gunner, seat_commander, seat_pax_1, seat_pax_2, seat_pax_3, ….
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.apc or place "prefab": "apc" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d(), vehicles().
